description: NPM bootstrapper for the DaVinci Resolve MCP Server.
author: Samuel Gursky

tool_signatures.name: audio
tool_signatures.description: Offline audio ops via system ffmpeg/ffprobe (must be on PATH — not bundled, FFmpeg is GPL;

tool_signatures.name: audio_plan
tool_signatures.description: Fairlight audio track planning + coverage/loudness analysis — offline, pure Node. Actions: list_templates, select_template, track_plan, analyze_coverage, check_loudness.

tool_signatures.name: capabilities
tool_signatures.description: Report available vs. setup-needed features. The core is pure-JS (always works); audio needs ffmpeg on PATH, conform.verify needs sharp, fairlight DB path needs better-sqlite3. Action: get.

tool_signatures.name: color_trace
tool_signatures.description: Better ColorTrace — match clips between a SOURCE and TARGET timeline (cross-project, from Project.db OR an exported .drp — the .drp route covers Postgres/network/cloud libraries — read-only, no Resolve) on media identity (pool id / file path / reel / file name + source-range overlap), names last → a trace plan with a lossless .drx per graded match and a plan.json for timeline_item_color.apply_trace_plan on the live server. Action: plan.

tool_signatures.name: conform
tool_signatures.description: Conform/relink QC engine (offline core).
